company_name: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. Common Shares
title: METALLA ANNOUNCES ADOPTION OF SHAREHOLDER RIGHTS PLAN
summary: Vancouver, British Columbia: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. (“Metalla” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: MTA) (TSXV: MTA) announces that the board of directors of Metalla (the “Board”) has approved the adoption of a shareholder rights plan (the “Rights Plan”), effective as of November 26, 2026 (the “Effective Date”), pursuant to a shareholder rights plan agreement entered into with Odyssey Trust Company, as rights agent.
body_markdown: Vancouver, British Columbia: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. (“Metalla” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: MTA) (TSXV: MTA) announces that the board of directors of Metalla (the “Board”) has approved the adoption of a shareholder rights plan (the “Rights Plan”), effective as of November 26, 2026 (the “Effective Date”), pursuant to a shareholder rights plan agreement entered into with Odyssey Trust Company, as rights agent.
